title: wedelia elliptica
intro: Wedelia elliptica, commonly known as Mexican daisy or wedelia, is a flowering plant species native to Central and South America. The health benefits of Wedelia elliptica include its ability to reduce inflammation and fever, as well as its use as an antiseptic to treat wounds and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia elliptica include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia elliptica include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
